messages:
elaine_docs: Heads up — small docs PR needed for the Console observability guide. Two things: 1) add a tiny latency vs cost breadcrumb snippet under the Dashboard section, and 2) fix a dead link in the tracing hook example that used the old trace key path. I can draft copy but need a quick code snippet someone from infra can confirm.

matt_eng: I can take the code part. Which file/guide is the dead link in?

elaine_docs: path is `docs/console/observability/dashboards.md` — link currently points to `/tracing/hooks/v1` which 404s. Also want a 3-line snippet showing attaching cost attributes to spans, e.g. `span.set_attribute('token_cost', cost)` so customers can surface cost in traces.

nina_sre: :eyes: OK. Prefer a span attribute name like `redwood.cost.tokens` to avoid collisions. Also include a note about cardinality (keep attributes numeric + low-cardinality).

matt_eng: Got it. Drafted a tiny snippet, pushed to a branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/abcd1234 — snippet: 
```python
with tracer.start_span('generate') as span:
    span.set_attribute('redwood.cost.tokens', tokens_used)
    span.set_attribute('redwood.latency.ms', latency_ms)
```
Keep it minimal so it renders clean in the markdown card.

leo_writer: Nice. For copy, let's say: "Attach low-cardinality numeric attributes (e.g., tokens, latency_ms) to spans so dashboards and cost breakdowns can correlate usage with latency." Short sentence. Also add a one-liner about sampling: "Ensure spans used for cost correlation are not dropped by aggressive sampling."

elaine_docs: Perfect. Two quick asks: 1) replace the bad link with `/tracing/hooks/latest` and 2) add the snippet under a small heading: "Correlating cost and latency". Can we also include the mkdocs live preview command for reviewers? `mkdocs serve --dev-addr=0.0.0.0:8000`

matt_eng: Done — PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/742 (includes link fix + snippet + short paragraph). I ran `mkdocs build` locally, no render errors.

docs-bot: Link check report: 1 broken link found in `docs/console/observability/dashboards.md` -> replaced in PR 742.

nina_sre: Reviewed the snippet, left a tiny nit: change `latency_ms` attribute to `redwood.latency.ms` to match our metric naming. Also can we add a one-line example query for the dashboard: `sum by (service) (rate(redwood_latency_ms_sum[5m])) / sum by (service) (rate(redwood_latency_ms_count[5m]))` — or maybe leave query ops to the dashboard owners.

leo_writer: I'll do the copy edits in the PR (small grammar and phrasing).

elaine_docs: Timeline? If we get one more approval I can merge end-of-day. @matt_eng did you add tests or a docs changelog entry?

matt_eng: Added a changelog note in `docs/CHANGELOG.md` and one html anchor test in `scripts/ci-docs-linkcheck.sh`. CI passed on my branch except a flake unrelated to this change.

nina_sre: Approved. :thumbsup:

leo_writer: Approved (copy). :white_check_mark:

elaine_docs: Thanks team — merging after CI finishes. I'll follow up to add an example dashboard panel in a separate PR if needed.

matt_eng: :rocket:

docs-bot: CI: docs-linkcheck passed for PR #742.

elaine_docs: merged. quick note: after merge I'll run the internal sweep to catch any similar old `/tracing/hooks/v1` links.

matt_eng: Thanks — can follow up with an example that wires span attributes into our trace-to-dashboard mapping if you want.

elaine_docs: Yes please, file a ticket and tag me.
